about: Attorney Kristine Grelish is the owner of Grelish Law PLLC with an office in Yakima and meeting space in Bellevue to serve her clients needs on both sides of the mountains. Kristine dedicates her practice to personal injury law, representing the injured and their families in cases involving motor vehicle, truck and pedestrian accidents. She also represents clients in cases involving wrongful death, defective products, and school bullying.

After graduating with honors from the University of British Columbia, Ms. Grelish earned her law degree from Seattle University School of Law, graduating summa cum laude. Following her graduation from law school, Ms. Grelish gained legal experience by serving as a clerk for a Washington State Court of Appeals judge. Today, she is admitted to practice in all Washington courts, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Washington and the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington.

Committed to education, Ms. Grelish served as an adjunct professor at Seattle University School of Law in the fall of 2013, teaching a class on insurance law, and has lectured at numerous seminars and conferences.

Ms. Grelish has traveled to many different regions of the world and participated as an observer for the 2006 Ukrainian parliamentary elections. Prior to attending law school, she taught English in Taiwan. Kristine has participated as a faculty volunteer for the nonprofit organization Justice Advocacy Africa, working with attorneys in Kenya and Botswana on various volunteer trips.

Recognized for her accomplishments within the legal profession, Kristine was selected to Super Lawyers Rising Star for the years 2010-2018 and selected to Super Lawyers 2019-2022. The National Trial Lawyers named Ms. Grelish to its "Top 40 Under 40" list 2012-2017. She is a member of the Washington State Bar Association, the Washington State Association for Justice, the American Bar Association and the American Association for Justice.
